name: potools
description: 本机文件工具平台 · Vite + React + Node sidecar + Tauri
author: pohoc <po.hoc4@gmail.com>

scripts.package:windows: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" XWIN_CROSS_COMPILER=clang XWIN_MSVC_SYSROOT_DOWNLOAD_URL=https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/trcrsired/windows-msvc-sysroot/releases/download/2026-01-16/windows-msvc-sysroot.tar.xz pnpm tauri build --bundles nsis --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.icons: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && pnpm --filter @potools/desktop exec tauri icon "$PWD/apps/desktop/src-tauri/app-icon.png"
